(rule!
 ;; 3x3 motifs -- a solid ring of one color around a single center cell --
 ;; reach toward a partner: the nearest object of the CENTER color that
 ;; lies outside the motif but shares its row-band or column-band. The
 ;; ring color is painted as a 3-wide corridor from the motif to one cell
 ;; past the partner, and center-color dots repeat every 3rd cell along
 ;; the corridor's middle line (aligned with the motif center).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode-list (map third (grid-cells g))))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (<= (max a1 b1) (min a2 b2)))
     (define motifs  ;; (r c ring-color center-color), row-major scan
       (filter values
               (for*/list ((r (range (- h 2))) (c (range (- w 2))))
                 (let* ((ring (for*/list ((dr (range 3)) (dc (range 3))
                                          #:when (not (and (= dr 1) (= dc 1))))
                                (at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc))))
                        (o (first ring))
                        (center (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
                   (and (!= o bg) (!= center bg) (!= o center)
                        (all? (lambda (v) (= v o)) ring)
                        (list r c o center))))))
     (define (color-objects color)  ;; objects of one color on a bg canvas
       (objects (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v color) color bg)) bg))
     (define (inside-motif? o mr mc)
       (all? (lambda (p) (and (>= (first p) mr) (<= (first p) (+ mr 2))
                              (>= (second p) mc) (<= (second p) (+ mc 2))))
             (obj-cells o)))
     (define (gap o mr mc)  ;; box distance from the motif's 3x3 box
       (+ (max 0 (- (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2)) (- mc (obj-c2 o)))
          (max 0 (- (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2)) (- mr (obj-r2 o)))))
     (define (best-object color mr mc)  ;; nearest banded partner, or #f
       (let ((cands (filter (lambda (o)
                              (and (not (inside-motif? o mr mc))
                                   (or (overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o)
                                                 mr (+ mr 2))
                                       (overlap? (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)
                                                 mc (+ mc 2)))))
                            (color-objects color))))
         (and (not (null? cands))
              (first (sort cands
                           (lambda (a b)
                             (cond ((not (= (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                    (< (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                   ((not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                    (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                   (else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))))))
     (define (paint-h out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the row band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-c2 o) mc) (max 0 (- (obj-c2 o) 1)) mc))
              (end (if (> (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2))
                       (min (- w 1) (+ (obj-c1 o) 1))
                       (+ mc 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range mr (+ mr 3)))
                                           (c (range start (+ end 1))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((c (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- c (+ mc 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg (+ mr 1) c center)
               gg))))
     (define (paint-v out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the col band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-r2 o) mr) (max 0 (- (obj-r2 o) 1)) mr))
              (end (if (> (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2))
                       (min (- h 1) (+ (obj-r1 o) 1))
                       (+ mr 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range start (+ end 1)))
                                           (c (range mc (+ mc 3))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((r (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- r (+ mr 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg r (+ mc 1) center)
               gg))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m motifs))
       (let* ((mr (first m)) (mc (second m))
              (ring (third m)) (center (fourth m))
              (o (best-object center mr mc)))
         (cond ((not o) out)
               ((overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) mr (+ mr 2))
                (paint-h out mr mc ring center o))
               (else (paint-v out mr mc ring center o))))))))
